execution_scope: Acquire and verify only the frozen MMRDR-UWF record and approved C0/C1/C2 public model assets needed by R1; do not train, benchmark, promote a champion, or provision cloud in R1-P0.

decision_policy.blocking_rule: Use BLOCKED only when continuing would invalidate the experiment, violate access/license/governance, create leakage, use corrupt or incompatible required R1 assets, or make R1 execution impossible.
decision_policy.warning_rule: Warnings remain recorded and carried into R1 artifacts; they do not stop a valid R1 experiment when no blocking finding remains.

blocking_examples: Unauthorized required dataset or model access
Corrupt or incomplete required R1 data
non_blocking_warning_examples: Unavailable row-level patient IDs while the official split is preserved
Deployment license restriction for a research-only candidate

evidence_required: Downloaded file manifest with source URLs, source IDs, byte sizes, SHA-256 values, and acquisition timestamp
Archive integrity result for every archive or multipart reconstruction
Extracted file inventory matched to the frozen manifest
No PHI, local private data, or unapproved mirror content
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED; do not create a training manifest or continue to schema checks.
blocking_conditions: Required MMRDR bytes are unauthorized, corrupt, incomplete, or do not match the frozen source record.
warning_conditions: Unknown pretraining overlap is recorded as a claim ceiling, not an archive failure.

checks.status_rule: Preserve MMRDR-UWF released train/test membership; never invent patient IDs or reshuffle sealed test data.
evidence_required: MMRDR UWF.csv schema and genuine ordinal label value audit
Split counts and duplicate/near-duplicate checks
Explicit ungradable handling and identity limitations
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED; update the R0/R1-P0 record with the exact discrepancy and do not train.
blocking_conditions: MMRDR target semantics, released split membership, or duplicate checks fail.
warning_conditions: Row-level patient IDs are unavailable while the released split is preserved.

checks.status_rule: Acquire only the exact C0, C1, and C2 source/revision recorded by R0; no silent substitution.
evidence_required: Local SHA-256 for every candidate checkpoint
Source/revision and license acceptance record
C1 overlap disclosure and C2 unknown-overlap disclosure
Local asset path below the configured model root
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED for the affected candidate; do not replace it with another encoder or fallback.
blocking_conditions: Required C0, C1, or C2 asset access is unauthorized or the local hash does not match the approved asset.
warning_conditions: Deployment or commercial rights remain restricted or require separate review for a research-eligible candidate.

checks.status_rule: Run preprocessing smoke on a permitted tiny public/synthetic sample and record the exact config hash.
evidence_required: C0 384px ImageNet preprocessing result
C1 exact FLAIR input/normalization result
C2 224px patch transform plus frozen 1024/5x224 letterbox geometry result
No image bytes committed to the repository
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED; correct the asset-specific preprocessing contract before any training.
blocking_conditions: Required candidate preprocessing is incompatible with the approved asset or target input contract.
warning_conditions: A claim ceiling or unresolved overlap does not change the frozen preprocessing contract.

checks.status_rule: Each candidate must load its approved local asset and execute a smoke forward pass without a synthetic fallback.
evidence_required: C0 checkpoint load log
C1 FLAIR load log
C2 DINOv3 local-repository load log
Model revision, SHA-256, and preprocessing hash recorded together
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED for the affected candidate; mark the asset unavailable or incompatible. Do not substitute TinyTestEncoder.
blocking_conditions: A required candidate cannot load its approved local asset or execute a smoke forward pass.
warning_conditions: A deployment license review remains separate from research model loading.

checks.status_rule: Complete and record only the access/terms steps required by the official MMRDR and C0/C1/C2 sources; no credentials or tokens enter Git.
evidence_required: MMRDR authorized access and applicable terms confirmation
C2 DINOv3 gated access and license acceptance confirmation when required
Access terms stored outside the repository; only safe status metadata committed
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED for the affected acquisition; do not use mirrors, scraped weights, or copied credentials.
blocking_conditions: Required R1 data or model access is unauthorized or terms cannot be accepted and recorded safely.
warning_conditions: A separate deployment/commercial license review is required after research eligibility is established.

checks.status_rule: Verify provider-neutral roots, sufficient local capacity, runtime dependencies, and offline/restricted-egress behavior before acquisition.
evidence_required: OCUFORGE_DATA_ROOT, OCUFORGE_MODEL_ROOT, OCUFORGE_CACHE_ROOT, and OCUFORGE_ARTIFACT_ROOT resolved
Capacity and permissions check for the future manifest
Runtime version and GPU/CPU class recorded where material
Public/synthetic-only cloud boundary confirmed; no cloud provisioning in P0
checks.failure_action: BLOCKED; repair storage/runtime configuration before downloading large archives.
blocking_conditions: Required roots, capacity, permissions, or runtime readiness are unavailable, or the public/synthetic boundary cannot be enforced.
warning_conditions: Provider choice is optional when the provider-neutral roots and governance boundary are satisfied.

known_warnings.finding: Foundation pretraining overlap with MMRDR cannot be fully established from the available source records.
Row-level patient IDs are unavailable while the official released split is preserved; no stronger identity claim is allowed.
C0 may be research-execution eligible under non-commercial terms, while deployment or commercial use remains restricted or review-required.
External-generalization claims remain capped until source-image membership and foundation pretraining overlap are resolved.

execution_receipt.owner_resolvable_next_action: Authenticate and accept the exact gated C2 asset through the official Hugging Face path, configure sufficient local OcuForge roots and runtime, and obtain an explicit governance decision for any IDRiD compute location before a new preflight.

deferred_datasets.preserved_policy: Keep unannotated regions UNKNOWN or WEAK_NEGATIVE unless exhaustive source evidence supports VERIFIED_TRUE_NEGATIVE.

deferred_checks: IDRiD image/mask identity and class-specific coverage
IDRiD released image-level split and conservative negative policy

completion_rule: R1-P0 is PASS when every required check is PASS and all evidence is recorded. It is PASS_WITH_WARNINGS when every required check is PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, all warnings are explicit with blocks_r1=false, no blocker remains, and the warning record is carried into every R1 artifact. It is BLOCKED only under the blocking rule.
next_gate: R1_GLOBAL_BENCHMARK=READY_NOT_EXECUTED after R1-P0 PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS with no blocking finding; operator still runs one candidate at a time and stops for human review.
